channel.title: The College Fix - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: WATCH: Students at this school have embraced the back-to-the-land movement
item.description: The College Fix’s Simon Olech explored the booming back-to-the-land movement at the Franciscan University of Steubenville, where the Agrarian club is booming as students have been driven by their Catholic faith to embrace an old fashioned, back-the-land lifestyle.

item.title: University of Maryland remains hotbed of anti-Israel activism
item.description: University of Maryland activists continue to push for cancellation of pro-Israel voices.

item.title: ‘Ban on Plato’: Professor says Texas A&M censored materials in contemporary morals class
item.description: Texas A&M University has demanded a philosophy professor remove Plato readings from his “Contemporary Moral Issues” class, citing a new directive against materials advocating race and gender ideology. The professor is accusing the university of censorship.

item.title: Trump cannot cap health research funding’s overhead costs, appeals court rules
item.description: The Trump administration had capped the rate at 15 percent, arguing previous rates were exorbitant, unaudited and often abused.

item.title: Harvard removes dean who bashed Trump, Rush Limbaugh, and ‘whiteness’
item.description: Harvard University removed residence hall Dean Gregory Davis following controversial social media posts where he criticized President Trump, police, and "whiteness."

item.title: Comms professors lament ‘racism and speciesism’ in animated films
item.description: Your favorite animated film may have racism and speciesism in it, professors claim.

item.title: Ibram Kendi’s new center reportedly launching this month at Howard U.
item.description: Ibram Kendi, a semester into the job, plans to launch a website soon for his think tank at Howard University.

item.title: ‘Queer food’ course at Boston U. explores what ‘polyamorous’ and ‘non-binary’ people eat
item.description: 'Queer food has always been,' Boston U. professor says.

item.title: Tennessee university reinstates professor fired for Charlie Kirk post, settles for $500,000
item.description: 'It was a very, very traumatic circumstance for him and his family,' lawyer said.

item.title: Jewish students locked in library during pro-Palestinian protest settle with NYC college
item.description: Cooper Union, a college in Manhattan, has settled a lawsuit with 10 Jewish students who alleged the institution failed to protect them during a pro-Palestinian protest in 2023.
